boundaries.description: Number of pages to display at each end of the numbered list.

compact-label.description: Localized stepper label template. Include {page} and {pages}.

href-template.description:
Relative or HTTP(S) URL template for native navigation. Place {page} in
the path, query or fragment, for example "?page={page}".

label.description: Accessible name of the navigation landmark. Distinguish multiple result sets.

load-more-label.description: Localized visible label for the button that appends results.

next-label.description: Localized accessible name of the control that requests the next page.

page.description: Current 1-based page. Update it when the requested results are ready.

page-label.description: Localized accessible name template for numbered controls. Include {page}.

pages.description: Total number of result pages. Omit it until a page count is available.

previous-label.description: Localized accessible name of the control that requests the previous page.

shown.description: Displayed result count in load-more mode. Update it after appending results.

siblings.description: Number of pages to display on each side of the current page.

status-label.description: Localized polite count template. Include {shown} and {total}.

total.description: Total result count in load-more mode. Required with shown for the count.

variant.description:
Numbered pages, a previous/next stepper, or a button to append results.
Numbered pages switch to the stepper below 480 CSS pixels of available width.

--ki-density-target-min.description: The smallest pointer target any density may produce: 24 x 24 CSS px by default and in compact (WCAG 2.5.8 AA), 44 x 44 in touch (WCAG 2.5.5). It floors a shrinking control but never lifts what a control paints: a control painted smaller extends its target to it, invisibly; rows and tabs grow to it (spec 045 A1).

--ki-focus-ring-color.description: Colour of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws: 3:1 or more against the page in every theme and scheme.

--ki-focus-ring-offset.description: Gap between a focusable component and its keyboard focus ring.

--ki-focus-ring-width.description: Thickness of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws (its outline). One token instead of one per component, so a mode or a theme changes every ring at once.

--ki-pagination-compact-gap.description: Gap between the compact count and direction controls.

--ki-pagination-current-bg.description: Background of the current page control.

--ki-pagination-current-fg.description: Ink for the current page control.

--ki-pagination-item-backdrop-filter.description: Complete backdrop filter for the page control.

--ki-pagination-item-bg.description: Resting background of a numbered page control.

--ki-pagination-item-bg-image.description: Optional image above the page control background color.

--ki-pagination-item-fg.description: Resting ink for page labels and status text.

--ki-pagination-item-hover-bg.description: Background of a hovered page control.

--ki-pagination-item-hover-fg.description: Ink for a hovered page control.

--ki-pagination-item-radius.description: Corner radius of numbered page controls and direction links.

--ki-pagination-item-size.description: Minimum size of a numbered page control at standard density.

--ki-pagination-more-gap.description: Gap between the load-more button and the count.

--ki-typography-family-body.description: semantic font family for typography family body.

--ki-typography-line-height-caption-2.description: semantic dimension for typography line height caption 2.

--ki-typography-size-body-1.description: semantic dimension for typography size body 1.

--ki-typography-size-caption-2.description: semantic dimension for typography size caption 2.

--ki-typography-weight-body-medium.description: semantic font weight for typography weight body medium.

component.description: Controls for moving among pages of results or appending the next batch.

ki-load-more.description: Requests another batch. Append results in place and update shown.

ki-page-change.description:
Requests a different page. Update results and move focus to their heading
when they are ready. Cancelling the event also cancels a plain link click.

compact.description: Current page and page count in the stepper.

list.description: Ordered list of pages in the numbered variant.
